Administrative Services

Office of The Proctor

The Proctor Office consists of the Proctor, a number of Assistant Proctors, and the Security Officer. The Proctor is directly responsible to the Vice Chancellor for the maintenance of discipline and conduct of students on the campus. Assistant Proctors and Security Officer assist the Proctor in maintaining discipline and security respectively on the campus.

Room: 602, Floor: 5, Building: 1, BUBT Main Campus

About the Office

BUBT maintains an excellent academic environment for higher education by maintaining a non-political and non-smoking environment, a safe and well-protected campus. BUBT campus is free from any type of drug abuse. Bullying or ragging is considered a criminal act at BUBT, and it follows zero tolerance for sexual harassment and crime. It also strives to keep its campus free from all sorts of nuisance, immoral activities and cyber-crimes. Campus is also free from terrorism, extremism, radicalism and all sorts of unsocial activities. With a safe and comfortable learning environment, BUBT ensures mutual respect and freedom for everyone.

Services of Our Office

Student Counseling and Disciplinary Briefing

Briefing and counseling students individually or in groups in cases of disciplinary lapses, aiming to promote awareness, correction, and responsible behavior.

Monitoring Student Discipline and Conduct

Regularly monitoring student activities to identify and address violations related to ID card usage, dress code, verbal or physical misconduct, bullying, ragging, sexual harassment, disorderly behavior, noise, or damage to university property.

Complaint Handling and Investigation

Receiving complaints from students and/or their parents or guardians, conducting preliminary investigations when necessary, and submitting reports to the Vice Chancellor for appropriate action.

Reporting Serious Violations

Promptly reporting serious or repeated violations of disciplinary rules to the Vice Chancellor to ensure timely administrative and legal decisions.

Campus Access Control and Security Support

Controlling unauthorized access to university premises and coordinating with faculty members and officers to enhance overall campus safety and security.

Coordination with Law Enforcement Agencies

Maintaining liaison with local police stations and other law enforcement agencies to ensure the safety and protection of students, staff, and university property when required.

Awareness and Preventive Programs

Organizing orientation programs and displaying notices, posters, and banners to raise awareness about anti-ragging, anti-bullying, drug abuse prevention, sexual harassment prevention, and other disciplinary issues.

Dissemination of Rules and Policies

Ensuring that disciplinary policies, rules, and prohibited actions are clearly communicated to students through orientations, the university website, and notice boards.

Additional Duties Assigned by Authority

Performing any other responsibilities assigned by the Vice Chancellor in support of maintaining discipline, safety, and a positive campus environment.
